title: Fourth Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for FY2020/2021
what_it_is: Fourth Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for FY2020/2021

sections.label: Fourth Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure
sections.summary: The Fourth Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021 are contained in Paper Cmd 6 of 2021, and with no amendments, the Heads of Expenditure are proposed to be taken en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Fourth Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021, contained in Paper Cmd 6 of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.
